title: SelectionToolsSetup
description: The user's language and the actions, asked for on the first selection. Whether the tools are on and whether the toolbar shows aren't here: they come with the feature's config, and later changes with selectionToolsConfigChanged.

userLanguage.description: The user's language as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. "fr-FR". Text in another language counts as foreign. English when absent.

actions.description: Actions in the order they should appear. "Ask" is built in and must not be listed.
